description_en: Alibaba Cloud provides SDKs in different languages to help you quickly integrate Alibaba Cloud products and services by using APIs. We recommend that you use an SDK to call APIs. In this way, you do not need to sign for verification.
description_zh: 在指定租户下创建一个新的数据库
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro create-database --database-name sms_pre --tenant-id t4pnum0000 --encoding utf8mb4 --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabase

parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。
不能使用某些预留关键字。例如：test, sys,oceanbase, information_schema, mysql, performance_schema
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.   
You cannot use reserved keywords, such as test and mysql.
parameters.help_zh: 租户 ID。仅支持 OceanBase MySQL 模式
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_zh:
数据库编码方式。  
目前支持 utf8mb4, utf16, gbk, gb18030, binary
parameters.name: encoding

parameters.help_en:
The encoding standard of the database.
For more information, see the Charset field returned by the DescribeCharset operation.
parameters.help_zh:
字符序。目前支持的字符序为：
Encoding 为 utf8mb4 时, Collation 支持 utf8mb4_general_ci,utf8mb4_bin,utf8mb4_unicode_ci。
Encoding 为 utf16 时, Collation 支持 utf16_general_ci,utf16_unicode_ci,utf16_bin。
Encoding 为 gbk 时, Collation 支持 gbk_chinese_ci,gbk_bin。
Encoding 为 gb18030 时, Collation 支持 gb18030_chinese_ci,gb18030_bin。
Encoding 为 binary 时, Collation 支持 binary
parameters.name: collation

parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。 从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。
ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The operation that you want to perform.   
Set the value to CreateDatabase.
parameters.name: description

DatabaseName.title_en: You can call this operation to create a database in a tenant.

```
http(s)://[Endpoint]/?Action=CreateDatabase
&DatabaseName=sms_pre
&TenantId=ob2mr3oae0****
&Encoding=utf8mb4
&InstanceId=ob317v4uif****
&ClientToken=123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000
&Description=This is a test database
&Common request parameters
```

schema.title_en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.
